nd: ND is a yellow trivalent metallic element of the rare earth group.
ND can also mean a state of north central United States bordering on Canada.
ND means the same as neodymium or atomic number 60 or North Dakota.
ndebele: Ndebele is a Bantu language sometimes considered a dialect of Zulu.
Ndebele means the same as Matabele.
ndjamena: Ndjamena is the capital and largest city of Chad.
Ndjamena means the same as N'Djamena or Fort-Lamy or capital of Chad.
